about: User stories of docs/PRODUCT.md (private repository, section 7) as journeys through /v2, each played from the position of a user group: its role (lay or tech), language and home organisation. target = true: the journey needs the proposal (map of users, UID pages) and is expected to fail until it is built; proposal: what would close the gap. Steps: go (hash route), fill [selector, text], click (selector), expect (visible selector), text (text in main).

ignore.about: Tokens that look like text keys but are data or technical terms shown on purpose: purpose scopes of the swiyu Trust Registry, the CT fallback marker and rating parameters on the methods page.

journeys.story: I want to find my municipality and see where it is red.
I want to see which providers mail, website and GEVER application rest on.
I want to compare myself with the best and see what they do differently.
I want to see the development from month to month (monthly report).
I want to get from a building block to the evidence of a host.
I want to see the canton with all its municipalities at a glance.
I want to see which providers many municipalities use at the same time.
I want to see my department with all its offices at a glance.
I want to understand which federal services cantons, municipalities and private organisations use.
journeys.proposal: Map of users on the page of the service (Confederation and offices as a list, cantons and municipalities as areas, education and critical services as points).

journeys.story: I want to see the dependency on foreign providers (certificates, cloud).
I want to see how trustworthy the public building blocks I build on are (swiyu).
I want to see my posture and compare it with my sector.
I want to see the public services used, with their operation (supply chain).
I want to see how providers perform for other customers.
I want to know which building blocks are replaceable.
I want to recognise which providers carry many critical services at the same time.
I want to trace every value back to its source (host, check, time).
I want to read the method and the weighting.
I want to understand within one minute where Switzerland holds its control points.
I want to get from a building block in the overview to the map of users.
journeys.proposal: Map of users on the page of the service (Confederation and offices as a list, cantons and municipalities as areas, education and critical services as points).

journeys.story: I want to understand in plain language whether my child's school communicates securely.
Where a UID is shown, I want to reach the organisation's own page with all its roles.
journeys.proposal: One page per UID with all roles; everywhere the name links to this page.

journeys.story: A provider with a UID has its own page, also without a measured domain («not measured»).
journeys.proposal: One page per UID also without a measured domain («not measured»); hosts to be searched later.
